columns.ts-mail-hold: server/src/pane/dialog.ts turnRunning (BUSY_RE) over the SGR-stripped last 8 rows: the mail lane holds a delivery with turn-running. Anchored, because a false busy held mail.
columns.ccd-enter: ccd/ccd _auto_stale_check: the unanchored grep that stands down before pressing Enter on a stale limit prompt. A false busy is the safe error.
columns.ccd-swap: ccd/ccd _swap_idle_gate: the unanchored grep that refuses an affinity move mid-turn. A false busy is the safe error.
columns.ccd-compact: ccd/ccd _idle_for_keystroke: the unanchored grep behind the compactor's and applier's keystroke. A false busy is the safe error.

busy: true means the caller treats the pane as a running turn (holds, stands down or refuses). All captures are judged over their last 8 rows, as every caller windows them.

scrollback-mention-midrow.txt.divergence: The phrase sits mid-row in prose. TS anchors the row end, so mail is not held; ccd's grep matches anywhere, so a keystroke is withheld. Intended: for ccd a false busy only waits a tick.

draft-with-phrase-paren.txt.divergence: A prompt-box draft that contains the phrase. TS excludes rows that start with the prompt glyph; ccd does not. Intended, per the ARCH-24 ticket.

draft-with-phrase-eol.txt.divergence: A draft row that ends with the phrase. Same reason as draft-with-phrase-paren: the prompt-glyph row is not a spinner for TS.

quoted-row.txt.divergence: A quoted row (starts with >). TS skips quote rows; ccd matches the phrase wherever it is.

tool-continuation.txt.divergence: A tool-output continuation row (starts with the continuation glyph). TS skips it; ccd matches it.
